## Trump struggles boost Democrats

Trump's slide in the polls in recent weeks could signify good news for Democrats ahead of November's midterm elections. In the newest Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats hold an 8-point lead over the GOP in a generic congressional ballot. [...] President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to yet another low since his return to the White House, according to a new Economist/YouGov poll, which also found that just 1 in 3 Americans approve of his job performance.
